node.title: Order-128 high-field folded-box exclusion
node.statement: For every odd prime p=1 mod 128 with p>253^32, every ternary vector v in {-1,0,1}^128 satisfying sum_i v_i zeta^i=0 at an exact order-128 root is antipodal/cyclotomic: v_i=v_(i+64) for all i. Odd-conjugate Parseval gives |Norm(W)|<=S^32; a non-even folded vector has S<=253, while an all-even vector divides by two and has norm at most 64^32.
node.notes: Pays the complete order-128 folded cube only above the exact field threshold. Lower fields, other orders, the universal row assignment, and value-set budget remain open.
